assertions.text: The document makes no claim about Ruth's values or personality that would fit most teachers equally well (for example that she cares about students or wants to make a difference) unless the claim is tied to specific evidence from her material.
assertions.evidence: values.md ties each trait to a quote — "Making a durable thing. 'Proudest thing I've made.'"; "Not selling herself... three times" — and rules out generics: "Not present in the evidence, and deliberately not assumed: status, income maximisation, management authority, public profile".

assertions.text: Each claim the document makes about Ruth's strengths or working patterns names its evidence: a specific project, role, number, or quoted piece of feedback from her material.
assertions.evidence: Strength claims carry named sources: "four separate people say so (Priya about Sam, Hannah about herself... 1,924 book buyers)"; "a commissioning editor... called it 'clearer than most of what crosses my desk'"; "six series, two years leading eleven markers, 'highly consistent'". Pattern claim quotes her own words ("Same wall: going out and drumming up strangers") and counts "Five instances... thr

assertions.text: The document names a pattern that distinguishes Ruth's abandoned efforts (the YouTube channel, the tutoring-agency website, the twice-deferred MSc application) from the efforts she finished.
assertions.evidence: "The three things you abandoned... died at the same step" — "**You complete obligations to named people and you abandon speculative self-promotion.** Five instances on one side, three on the other, no exceptions in either direction," with quotes ("drumming up strangers") and finished-work examples.

assertions.text: The document uses her Teachers' Pension figures (the £14,800 a year already accrued, or the roughly £908 a year that each further year of service adds) when weighing any path that involves leaving employed teaching.
assertions.evidence: Path 2 (clean exit): "Deferring the pension at 49… costs you £4,886 a year for life… pension at 68 of £19,243, against £27,139 on path 1". Plus the table "If you leave the scheme… Now, age 46 | £14,800 … Never (active to 68) | £20,656" and part-time accrual "£324 a year of new pension".

assertions.text: The document states what full-time freelance science writing typically pays and compares that against the income Ruth's outgoings require.
assertions.evidence: No pay figure for freelance science writing. Only qualitative: "most of our freelancers file for several outlets and still don't make a living from features alone." And: "I could not find a reliable published rate... the £3,000–£10,000 a year... is a placeholder" (educational publishing, not features). No comparison to the £37,704 outgoings.

assertions.text: Ruth's actual submission record (11 pitches, 2 acceptances, £220 earned) is used as evidence when the document assesses her prospects as a writer.
assertions.evidence: "Your eleven pitches produced two acceptances, which is an 18% hit rate — not actually bad — but they were all explainers" and "Forces First … has earned £6,290. Eleven pitches over two years … have earned £220. You already ran this experiment."

assertions.text: Each proposed path is given its own distinct way of failing, different from the failure modes of the other paths.
assertions.evidence: Distinct falsifiers per path: B "It has already fired. Twice in 2025"; 1 "the problem is not the scale of the classroom, it is being in a school"; 2 "self-employed income has not reached £20,000... It does not pay the bills"; 3 "the only path that runs out of money... whether you can report"; 4 "Training days are still performance to a room" plus "ITT roles drift toward management".

assertions.text: Every proposed path states an observable sign, within a stated time window, that would show the path is not working.
assertions.evidence: All five carry dated falsifiers: B "two full calendar years... no voice loss"; 1 "whether you lose your voice again in the 2027/28 academic year"; 2 "by the end of 2028, your self-employed income has not reached £20,000"; 3 "By 31 March 2027, file one reported feature pitch"; 4 "more CPD delivery in 2027 and your voice goes again".

assertions.text: At least one option is explicitly ruled out, deferred, or restructured because her £8,412 of savings cover only about three months of outgoings.
assertions.evidence: analysis.md: "£8,412 of savings against £31,704 ... is about three months. No path may require more than about £6,000 of drawdown". Path 2 is restructured accordingly: "2026–2028 ... treat these as build years ... Bank everything you can — this path needs a much bigger cash buffer than you have."

assertions.text: No recommended step requires Ruth to leave the Sheffield area before Alice finishes school in summer 2029.
assertions.evidence: Recommended path 1's pre-2029 steps are all Sheffield-local: apply for the exam board role ("most of it remote"), write book, "ask for four days a week from September", "Sept 2027… Drop to 0.8 FTE" at Ashworth. The pitch is "on a physics subject you can reach from Sheffield".

assertions.text: The document commits to one recommended direction for Ruth, with its reasoning stated, rather than presenting the paths as equally weighted choices for her to pick from.
assertions.evidence: "I recommend **path 1, the assessment spine**" — followed by "The reasoning, before the conclusion": completion record, "The exam board email is the writing career", "£5,856 a year for life" pension argument, plus stated cost "£16,000 a year of pension… £67,000 of savings".

assertions.text: The document names the conflict between Ruth's statement that she is not a leader and the evidence of her leading in her record (running staff training, leading an exam-marking team of 11, mentoring early-career teachers), rather than silently accepting either side.
assertions.evidence: LIFE_PATHS.md, "What I am not recommending": "I do not think you are wrong about yourself. Every leadership role you have taken and enjoyed is expert authority — eleven examiners, an INSET room, two mentees — and none of it is line management. Four people read you as a leader and they are right about the authority and wrong about the form."

assertions.text: The recommended path's first steps are specific enough to begin within a few weeks: a named request, application, message, or task, not an instruction to explore, reflect, or network.
assertions.evidence: Path 1's near-term actions are named tasks with dates: "This week: email the exam board. Ask the fee for the APE role and how the twenty days fall"; "Before 26 September: apply"; "This month: phone Teachers' Pensions"; "Raise your tutoring rate to £45"; "Start *Forces First: Paper 2* in September."

assertions.text: The document names external events (in her school, the exam system, her finances, or Alice's plans) that should cause the plan to be re-examined.
assertions.evidence: "Tripwires… 5. **Teachers' Pension policy.** Watch the accrual rate (1/57)… *If revaluation is cut:* the case for staying an active member weakens… 6. **Alice.** If she stays in Sheffield for university, your 2029 costs do not fall as modelled." Plus tripwire 2 (exam board ladder stalls → switch to path 4) and 7 (mortgage date).
